# Bundled runtime notices

The self-contained Windows package redistributes Microsoft .NET / Windows Desktop runtime 10.0.11.
`dotnet/` contains the license and third-party notices copied from the official runtime NuGet packages used for this build. These runtime files retain their respective licenses; the project's MIT license does not replace them.

When updating the runtime packages, refresh these notice files from the matching packages before publishing. macOS uses platform frameworks and does not bundle a .NET runtime.
